requirements.text: Students should be able to colour-code modules in their personalised timetable.
Students should be able to hide cancelled classes in their personalised timetable using a toggle option.
Students should be able to block out study times using a drag-and-drop feature in their personalised timetable.
Students should be able to sync or export their customised timetables to calendar applications such as Google Calendar or Outlook.
The notification system should allow students to configure their preferences for receiving alerts.
Students should receive notifications for new grades, assignment deadlines, and exam dates.
The notification system should support push notifications through the portal, email alerts, and potentially SMS notifications.
Students should be able to provide feedback on content quality, lecturer effectiveness, and resources via a user-friendly online form.
The feedback submission process should include both quantitative ratings and qualitative comments.
Feedback must remain anonymous until grades are submitted.
Aggregated feedback should be accessible to module coordinators for review.
New features must integrate seamlessly with the existing portal's authentication system.
The existing student records database schema cannot be modified.
Enhancements must comply with GDPR and university data retention policies.
New features should not degrade the performance or response time of the existing portal.
